caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornately designed chair placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The chair features a rich reddish-purple, tufted fabric that covers both the backrest and the seat, with each tuft marked by a dark button. The backrest has a wide, slightly concave, trapezoidal shape with carved wood framing the sides and a prominent decorative crest at the top, which includes scrollwork and a central circular medallion. The sides of the backrest curve inwards before meeting the upper seat. The seat itself is also padded and has a rounded, slightly bulging front edge. Beneath the seat, the wooden frame continues, decorated with two large, round medallion motifs at the front corners. The chair stands on four turned wooden legs; the front legs are smoothly carved and have small brass casters at the feet, while the rear legs are more simply shaped and angle slightly outward. The exposed wooden elements are brown with subtle grain patterns and decorative carvings. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the drawing.
title: Chair
